training.convergence_note: Loss decreased smoothly from 3.95 to 2.45 across 20 epochs; healthy training, but predictions don't beat baseline

diagnosis: R80 trained cleanly (loss 3.95 -> 2.45) and recovered 6 h7 cases R54c missed. But it lost 17 cases R54c had right and net-regressed across all subsets. Same fundamental failure mode as R76 (small residual MLP): any neural model on these features chases semantic similarity neighbors and breaks R54c's calibrated same-artist preference. The richer architecture (transformer + cross-candidate attention) extracts MORE signal (recovery=6 vs R76's 0) but still cannot beat R54c on the same top-300 pool.
phase_1_status: CANCELLED per predeclared rule: 'if Phase 0B fails, ARCHIVE'
interpretation: All three neural architectures over the R54-stacked top-300 pool lose net h7 with same-artist regression. The bottleneck is FEATURE INFORMATION, not architecture. The available LR + R68 BGE + semantic features don't carry enough new signal beyond R54c LR to overcome the cost of disrupting calibration.
